entries.title: Another computer on the welcome screen says it plainly
entries.body: At the first launch, the Another computer choice now reads "Let me run on another computer. You control me from here.", in every language the app speaks.

picture.alt: The welcome screen under the lower edge of the first mate's character: Welcome aboard Infinitary, Captain, the question Where should I live?, and three choices, with Another computer reading Let me run on another computer. You control me from here.
